asked.item: Is seeing only 60 credits and no bonus normal during the trial?
Where/when the signup offer bonus credits appear

verdict.reason: The cited sentences state that during the free trial only the 60-credit trial balance is shown and that promotional bonus credits are added when the paid subscription activates, which answers whether this is normal.

steps.text: Yes, during the free trial you see only the trial credit balance of 60 credits.
Promotional bonus credits, such as ones from a signup offer, are added when your paid subscription activates.
The bonus credits appear after the trial ends and your first payment processes.
